title: The Carabiner's 4 mm fillet on its 8 mm top face and the chamfer's top edges (it was held at 3.99)

expect.note: book parity report, Project 5. An 8 x 8 section swept round a closed outline of two lines and two half circles (15722.48), the bottom chamfered 2 mm, then fillet 4 on the top face's two edge loops and the chamfer's two top edge loops. The two 4 mm rounds use up the 8 mm top face exactly: OpenCASCADE's fillet fails at 4.0 (3.99 builds), Fission 180 sweeps the second round's section (fillet_section.py). On the straight runs the two top rounds remove 2 * (16 - 4 pi) per mm exactly; round the bends a round's section sweeps a little more outside and less inside, so the whole is FreeCAD's number, checked against the 3.99 build (8.4 mm3 less removed)
